model: CS204AB True UHV closed-cycle cryostat (DE-204AB cold head, ARS-4HW compressor)
family: closed-cycle GM UHV cold head / cryostat for insertion in a UHV chamber
description: Welded, metal-sealed True UHV (1e-11 Torr) GM cold head on a 6 in rotatable CF flange, <9 K base (<10-350 K range), 0.1 K stability, bakeable to 80 C (200 C with displacer removed), open-ended nickel-plated copper radiation shield, 10-pin feedthrough with 4 sample wires; the standard platform for UHV ice-deposition (laboratory astrochemistry), surface-science and photoemission sample cooling.

configurations.name: CS204AB typical configuration (DE-204AB, ARS-4HW, 6 in CF flange, 10-pin feedthrough, 4 sample wires)
configurations.configuration_basis: ARS CS204AB typical configuration per data sheet DS-CS204AB: DE-204AB cold head, ARS-4HW compressor, two helium hoses, welded stainless instrumentation skirt with 6 in rotatable CF flange, open-ended radiation shield, 10-pin UHV/hermetic feedthroughs with heater, control diode and calibrated sample diode, 4 copper experimental wires, temperature controller. It is mounted in the customer UHV chamber (chamber, pumps and viewports not part of the ARS supply). Options NOT fitted: 4 K / 5.5 K cold heads, 450/800 K interfaces, turbo upgrade. Cooling powers and cooldown are the conservative 50 Hz values.

unknowns.why: The quoted row is labelled DE-202AI, a different cold head, not the DE-204AB in this configuration. It is probably a copy-paste error in the CS204*B sheet, but the 350 K upper bound is not stated for the DE-204AB, so the value is not documented for this exact model.

The absence rests only on the options list not mentioning a magnet. The sheet says 'Fully Customizable', and the sample sits in the customer's own UHV chamber, which ARS does not supply. Nothing states there is no field, and the options list is not a complete statement of the sample environment.

'True UHV (10-11 Torr)' is a compatibility rating of the cold head's seals. The attained pressure depends on the customer's chamber and pumps, which are not part of the ARS supply, as the claim itself admits. It is not a base pressure this configuration guarantees.
